title: Agentic Abstention: Do Agents Know When to Stop Instead of Act?
task: Deciding when agents should abstain from tool use under uncertainty
key_results: CONVOLVE improves timely abstention on WebShop from 26.7% to 57.4% recall; agents show inconsistent patterns of abstention across 28,000+ tasks
comments: Identifies a critical gap in agent behavior—agents either never abstain or abstain only after excessive interactions—revealing that scale and reasoning don't guarantee good abstention timing.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Larger models improve timely abstention
hypotheses.result: False; larger/more capable models sometimes perform worse at timely abstention

title: LiveEdit: Towards Real-Time Diffusion-Based Streaming Video Editing
task: Real-time streaming video editing with content preservation
key_results: 12.66 FPS on streaming video editing with state-of-the-art visual quality; AR-oriented mask cache reduces redundant processing
comments: Three-stage distillation from bidirectional to unidirectional model is a clever approach to maintaining fidelity while enabling real-time inference on consumer hardware.

title: Scaling the Horizon, Not the Parameters: Reaching Trillion-Parameter Performance with a 35B Agent
task: Scaling agent performance via long-horizon trajectories rather than parameter scaling
key_results: 35B MoE model (Agents-A1) matches or exceeds 1T-parameter models on SEAL-0 (56.4), IFBench (80.6), HiPhO (46.4), FrontierScience-Olympiad (79.0)
comments: Demonstrates that horizon scaling with multi-teacher distillation can be more efficient than raw model scaling; connects external knowledge, actions, and verifier outcomes in 45K-token trajectories.

outputs: long-horizon trajectory with actions and observations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Horizon scaling can replace parameter scaling for agentic tasks
hypotheses.result: True; 35B model reaches 1T-level performance on multiple benchmarks

title: TUA-Bench: A Benchmark for General-Purpose Terminal-Use Agents
task: Evaluating general-purpose terminal-use agents across diverse real-world tasks
key_results: Claude Code with Opus 4.8 achieves 65.8% on TUA-Bench; substantial gaps across document editing, email, web seeking, and scientific workflows
comments: First benchmark to systematically evaluate terminal agents beyond programming tasks; execution-based scoring on real terminal with deterministic setup.

title: Trimming the Long-Tail of Visual World Modeling Evaluation
task: Evaluating visual world models on rare and irregular physical interactions
key_results: Clear long-tail gap; performance drops from Regular to Unconventional (affordance generalization) to Impossible (constraint awareness) scenarios
comments: Tailor-Bench reveals that models rely on superficial patterns; image models fail state changes, video models suffer temporal inconsistencies even on common tasks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Visual world models generalize physical principles across tool-task pairs
hypotheses.result: False; limited generalization beyond common interactions; heavy reliance on superficial visual patterns

title: Beyond IID: How General Are Tabular Foundation Models, Really?
task: Unified benchmarking for tabular foundation models across diverse scenarios
key_results: Tabular foundation models excel on tiny-to-medium IID data but traditional tree/deep-learning models dominate on non-IID, large, high-dimensional datasets
comments: BeyondArena with 142 curated datasets reveals that foundation model advantages are narrower than claimed; honest evaluation shows gaps on realistic challenges.

model_io.model: Tabular foundation models + tree/deep learning baselines

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tabular foundation models are broadly superior
hypotheses.result: False; they excel only on small-to-medium IID tasks; traditional methods remain dominant on challenging scenarios

title: Video-MME-Logical: A Controlled Diagnostic Benchmark for Video Temporal-Logical Reasoning
task: Evaluating video temporal-logical reasoning in multimodal LLMs
key_results: Substantial human-model gap on temporal-logical operations (state tracking, sequential counting, ordering, dynamic spatiality); SFT on 500K samples insufficient to close gap
comments: Video-MME-Logical isolates temporal reasoning from scene complexity via controlled generation; intermediate-state diagnostics reveal models fail to maintain logical traces.

hypotheses.hypothesis: MLLMs can perform temporal-logical reasoning over video
hypotheses.result: Limited; substantial gaps especially as complexity increases; supervised fine-tuning shows limited gains

title: AsyncOPD: How Stale Can On-Policy Distillation Be?
task: Asynchronous on-policy distillation with stale policy data
key_results: AsyncOPD achieves 1.6x-3.8x throughput improvement over synchronous training with comparable accuracy; KL direction affects staleness robustness
comments: Systematic study reveals forward KL more robust to stale rollouts than reverse KL; multi-sample MC preserves correctability while reducing variance.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Asynchronous RL stabilization methods help OPD with stale data
hypotheses.result: False; simpler OPD-specific approach (recomputing reverse-KL at learner time) outperforms

title: ReFreeKV: Towards Threshold-Free KV Cache Compression
task: Threshold-free KV cache compression for LLM inference
key_results: ReFreeKV adapts budget allocation without pre-determined thresholds; maintains full-cache performance across 13 diverse datasets
comments: Addresses practical limitation of threshold-dependent pruning methods; enables robust deployment on open-domain inputs without domain-specific tuning.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Threshold-dependent KV pruning generalizes to arbitrary inputs
hypotheses.result: False; domain-specific thresholds cause large degradation on diverse inputs

title: Monte Carlo Energy Aggregation for Mobile 3D Gaussian Splatting
task: Mobile 3D Gaussian Splatting with reduced overhead
key_results: Flux-GS reduces parameters substantially while maintaining competitive visual quality; 14-15 FPS on RTX 4090 at 480p native resolution
comments: Monte Carlo specular energy aggregation + attribute-conditioned SH enhancement preserve fidelity without distillation; multi-view guidance improves densification.

title: Bridging VideoQA and Video-Guided Agentic Tasks via Generalized Keyframe Extraction
task: Connecting video QA with video-guided GUI task learning via keyframe extraction
key_results: TASKER achieves +2.0% on EgoSchema, +1.8% on NExT-QA; improves both video QA and video-guided agentic tasks
comments: Task-driven and scene-aware keyframe extraction bridges seemingly disparate tasks; demonstrates that keyframe selection is bottleneck for video understanding.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Task-aware keyframe selection improves video understanding uniformly
hypotheses.result: True; gains on both QA and agentic tasks

title: TACO: Tool-Augmented Credit Optimization for Agentic Tool Use
task: Crediting tool contributions in code-tool agents via process rewards
key_results: TACO achieves consistent accuracy gains; DAPR credits/debits tools accurately without external judge; OGAR suppresses wasted tool calls
comments: Clever use of probe tokens to measure tool value via prediction difference; parameter-free OGAR routing shows when tools actually help.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Probe-based differential rewards can credit tool contributions accurately
hypotheses.result: True; yields consistent gains across perception, reasoning, and multimodal benchmarks

title: Interleaved Speech Language Models Latently Work In Text
task: Analyzing latent mechanisms of speech-text interleaved LMs via logit lens
key_results: Models undergo implicit transcription phase where text token becomes decodable (77% of data); proceed to predict in text space before transforming back
comments: Logit lens reveals models operate in text latent space despite being trained speech-to-speech; interleaving data and text-LM initialization both critical.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Interleaved SLMs work in text latent space
hypotheses.result: True; implicit transcription phase visible in intermediate layers regardless of speech-only training

title: OSWorld2.0: Benchmarking Computer Use Agents on Long-Horizon Real-World Tasks
task: Evaluating computer-use agents on long-horizon realistic workflows
key_results: Claude Opus 4.8 with max thinking completes only 20.6% of 108 tasks (54.8% partial); tasks require avg 318 tool calls vs 30 in v1.0
comments: OSWorld 2.0 captures real workflow complexity (median 1.6 hours per task for humans); reveals agents lose constraint tracking, miss mid-task info, skip verification.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Frontier agents reach professional-level computer use
hypotheses.result: False; far from professional-level; agents struggle with hidden state, constraint tracking, and implicit requirements

title: DreamForge-World 0.1 Preview: A Low-Compute Real-Time Controllable World Model
task: Real-time controllable world modeling on consumer GPUs
key_results: DreamForge-World 0.1 achieves 14-15 FPS on RTX 4090 at 480p; supports keyboard/mouse control, multimodal init, minute-scale rollouts
comments: Preview system prioritizes low-compute adaptation over frontier quality; demonstrates practical route to consumer-GPU interactive simulation.

title: GUICrafter: Weakly-Supervised GUI Agent Leveraging Massive Unannotated Screenshots
task: Weakly-supervised GUI agent learning from massive unannotated screenshots
key_results: GUICrafter achieves competitive performance to UI-TARS using only 0.1% of annotated data; surpasses GUI-R1 under same data budget
comments: Curriculum learning on unannotated data + RL calibration on small high-quality set is data-efficient; visual grounding learned without human annotations.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Large-scale unannotated data can reduce annotation burden for GUI agents
hypotheses.result: True; visual grounding from unannotated data + minimal labeled data matches or exceeds annotation-heavy baselines

title: How Good Can Linear Models Be for Time-Series Forecasting?
task: Evaluating time-series forecasting with optimal preprocessing vs. large models
key_results: Optimized Ridge regression beats Transformer/MLP/CNN baselines on 6/8 benchmarks; optimal lookback non-monotonic in horizon
comments: Challenges scaling assumption; optimal context length is series-specific and often inverse with horizon. Local normalization over learned trailing fraction preferred universally.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Longer horizons require longer context in time-series forecasting
hypotheses.result: False; fitted exponents range -0.19 to +0.46, often negative (shorter history better for longer horizons)

title: MIMFlow: Integrating Masked Image Modeling with Normalizing Flows for End-to-End Image Generation
task: End-to-end image generation via masked image modeling and normalizing flows
key_results: MIMFlow achieves 71.3% linear probing, FID 2.50 on ImageNet 256×256 with 50% fewer tokens than baselines; 32.8% gain over NF baseline
comments: Decouples generative task: NF models semantic manifold, specialized decoder handles high-frequency. Resolves capacity bottleneck of strict invertibility.

title: Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Image: Advancing Masked Discrete Diffusion for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
task: High-resolution masked discrete diffusion for text-to-image synthesis
key_results: GenEval 0.90, DPG 86.9, HPSv3 10.76; token-editing mechanism and Grouped Cross-Entropy improve fidelity and training efficiency
comments: Token-editing enables self-correction post-unmasking; GCE alleviates sparsity from large vocabularies. Fused operator significantly reduces VRAM.

title: PolicyGuard: A Dialogue-Grounded Sub-Agent Verifier for Policy Adherence in LLM Agents
task: Sub-agent verifier ensuring policy adherence in multi-turn agentic workflows
key_results: PolicyGuard improves PASS4 by +12.0/+6.0/+12.0 pp across vendors (GPT, Claude, Gemini); achieves higher violation recall with ~50% fewer blocks
comments: Sub-agent with full dialogue context + policy self-reasoning + actionable feedback outperforms argument-level guards; conversation-specific remediation critical.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Policy adherence requires conversation-specific reasoning
hypotheses.result: True; dialogue-grounded sub-agent beats argument-only safeguards

title: Walking in the Implicit: Interactive World Exploration via Neural Scene Representation
task: Interactive world exploration via neural implicit scene representation
key_results: NeuWorld achieves strong long-horizon consistency with favorable inference efficiency; reuses VAE encoder as unified conditioner for heterogeneous inputs
comments: Scene-centric paradigm shifts from frame latents to fixed-length renderable NIS; factorizes into stochastic state transition and deterministic rendering.

title: Cognitive Episodes in LLM Reasoning Traces Enable Interpretable Human Item Difficulty Prediction
task: Predicting human item difficulty from LRM reasoning traces via cognitive episodes
key_results: Epi2Diff achieves 8.1% average relative gain over supervised LLM fine-tuning on SAT benchmarks; maps traces into cognitively grounded episodes
comments: Harder items induce more effortful, iterative, implementation-centered episodes rather than merely longer responses. Episode dynamics reveal hidden structures.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cognitive episodes in reasoning traces predict human difficulty
hypotheses.result: True; episode-based features outperform semantic representation alone

title: ZooClaw-FashionSigLIP2: Distilled Fine-tuning for Robust Fashion Retrieval
task: Fashion-specialized vision-language retrieval with knowledge distillation
key_results: ZooClaw-FashionSigLIP2 outperforms all baselines including 1B-parameter models; 50% fewer tokens than standard models via full fine-tuning + distillation + weight interpolation
comments: Resolves foundation-model adaptation tradeoff via simple recipe: fine-tuning + distillation + weight interpolation. New ZooClaw-Fashion benchmark with quality analysis.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Knowledge distillation + weight interpolation preserve generalization in specialized adaptation
hypotheses.result: True; outperforms LoRA and larger backbones

title: Focusing on What Matters: Saliency-Harnessing Accurate Routing for Diffusion MoE
task: Routing salient tokens accurately in diffusion MoE
key_results: SharpMoE improves routing by using clean latent features as guidance; trajectory routing loss ensures precise allocation throughout denoising; plug-and-play enhancement
comments: Post-training framework identifies router failure: noise-corrupted features prevent salient-token distinction. Clean guidance + trajectory constraint solve it.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Routing in diffusion MoE can use noise-free guidance for saliency
hypotheses.result: True; clean latents improve routing accuracy, enabling plug-and-play enhancement

title: Beyond Drug Discovery: The Nanotechnology Molecular Optimization (NMO) Benchmark
task: Generative molecular design for nanotechnology with quantum-based optimization
key_results: NMO benchmark reveals advanced optimization underperforms simple baselines; novel baseline with structural constraints + domain-agnostic pretraining surpasses state-of-the-art
comments: Bridges ML and quantum materials science; strict structural constraints and rugged fitness landscapes challenge drug-discovery-trained models.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Drug-discovery pretraining transfers to nanotechnology molecular design
hypotheses.result: False; domain-agnostic pretraining + structural constraint modeling outperforms

title: SafePyramid: A Hierarchical Benchmark for In-context Policy Guardrailing
task: Evaluating guardrails on in-context policy adherence across domains and complexity
key_results: GPT-5.5 achieves only 54.0% L0, 35.3% L1, 12.9% L2 rule violation identification on SafePyramid; reveals policy reasoning gaps
comments: Three-level difficulty (rule understanding → dependency reasoning → novel framework adaptation); 3,000 policies with 61K rules expose limitations of current guardrails.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLMs can reliably apply in-context policy guardrails
hypotheses.result: False; substantial performance drops across complexity levels; dependency reasoning and adaptation are weak

title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Video Diffusion Models for Hand Motion Reconstruction
task: 4D hand motion reconstruction from egocentric video via video diffusion models
key_results: ViDiHand substantially outperforms prior methods on ARCTIC, HOT3D, HOI4D; leverages pretrained video diffusion without detector, infiller, or test-time optimization
comments: Repurposes video generative model representations for hand pose; hand-overlay rendering objective specializes features while preserving world priors.

model_io.model: Pretrained video diffusion model + hand pose decoder

hypotheses.hypothesis: Video diffusion representations transfer to hand pose reconstruction
hypotheses.result: True; achieves strong results via hand-overlay specialization without task-specific pretraining

title: TheoremGraph: Bridging Formal and Informal Mathematics
task: Unified statement-level dependency graph bridging informal and formal mathematics
key_results: 11.7M theorems + 18.3M informal dependencies; 388K Lean declarations; 47,952 informal-formal matches at 0.8 cosine; LLM judge 87% acceptance at >=0.9 tier
comments: TheoremGraph and LeanGraph connect informal papers and formal libraries; enables mathematical search, attribution, and retrieval-augmented reasoning.

model_io.model: Theorem extractor + dependency parser + semantic embedder

title: ReasoningLens: Hierarchical Visualization and Diagnostic Auditing for Large Reasoning Models
task: Hierarchical visualization and auditing of long reasoning traces
key_results: ReasoningLens structures traces into interactive hierarchies; agentic auditor autodetects errors; reveals model-specific reasoning blind spots
comments: Addresses transparency burden of exceptionally long CoT; separates strategy from execution; open-source framework for interpreting next-gen reasoning models.

title: Illuminating Unified Multimodal Model for Free-form Interleaved Text-Image Generation
task: Free-form interleaved text-image sequence generation with multimodal efficiency
key_results: ILLUME-X outperforms previous unified models on style transfer, image decomposition, storytelling; ILScore benchmark for interleaved evaluation
comments: Progressive training with self-adaptive objectives + expanded data pipeline enables autonomous free-form generation; comprehensive evaluation method needed.

title: One Forward Beats Two: InnerZoom for Accurate and Efficient GUI Grounding
task: Single-forward GUI grounding via cross-layer evidence bridging
key_results: InnerZoom achieves 64.7 on OSWorld-G, 40.2 UI-Vision, 73.1 OSWorld-GR, 87.6 MMBench-GUI; 31.8% latency reduction vs. two-pass methods
comments: Avoids expensive crop-and-rerun by preserving target-region awareness from intermediate layers through inference; matches two-pass accuracy with single forward.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Two-pass zooming is necessary for accurate GUI grounding
hypotheses.result: False; single-forward cross-layer evidence bridging achieves comparable accuracy with significantly lower latency

title: PoseShield: Neural Collision Fields for Human Self-Collision Resolution
task: Neural collision constraint for SMPL-based human pose self-collision resolution
key_results: PoseShield achieves 95.8% success rate; operates in low-dimensional pose space with Eikonal regularization; extends to motion sequences without retraining
comments: Formulates collision as constrained optimization grounded in PDE theory; generator-agnostic post-hoc corrector enables broad applicability.

title: Learning Transferable Dynamics Priors from Action to World Modeling
task: Learning transferable dynamics priors from action-conditioned world modeling
key_results: A2World pretrained on large-scale robot data; transfers to task/scene-specialized simulator (A2World-sim) and policy model (A2World-policy)
comments: Multi-view interactive diffusion captures reusable interaction dynamics beyond appearance; benefits both simulator-centric and policy-centric robot learning.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Action-conditioned world model pretraining transfers to robot learning
hypotheses.result: True; benefits both simulator and policy adaptation from shared pretrained weights

title: Geometric Stability of Neural Population Codes: Regional Variation, Behavioral Relevance, and Circuit Dependence
task: Analyzing geometric stability of neural population codes independent of temporal stability
key_results: Geometric stability (Shesha) predicts neural-behavioral coupling (ρ=0.18) while centroid drift does not; hierarchy opposite to temporal stability; recurrent excitatory coupling amplifies consistency
comments: Identifies orthogonal axis of representational analysis; pairwise distance structure within sessions reveals functional relevance independent of drift.

model_io.model: Neural population decoder + geometric stability metric

hypotheses.hypothesis: Temporal stability and geometric stability are independent measures

title: One Scene, Two Depths: Probing Geometric Ambiguity in Monocular Foundation Models
task: Probing depth ambiguity in monocular foundation models via transparent scenes
key_results: Depth models exhibit diverse layer preferences; Laplacian Visual Prompting can shift reported layer; DAv2-L achieves 75.5% multi-layer SRA
comments: Multi-layer ordinal benchmark (MD-3k) reveals models express complementary geometric hypotheses; depth supervision is convention, not ground truth.

inputs: RGB image or (RGB + LVP spectral feature)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Monocular depth estimation has single correct answer
hypotheses.result: False; layered geometry admits multiple valid interpretations; models express different valid hypotheses

title: Large-Scale Tunnel Air-Ground Collaboration With FLISP: Fast LiDAR-IMU Synchronized Path Planner
task: Cooperative UGV-UAV tunnel inspection with unified sensor-driven path planning
key_results: FLISP achieves 100% success rate with 7ms latency in 1.2km operational tunnel; 7× speedup over grid-based, three orders of magnitude vs. sampling-based
comments: Mapless paradigm eliminates rasterization overhead; single LiDAR-IMU drives both platforms; hierarchical refinement ensures kinematic feasibility.

title: RaysUp: Ultra-light Universal Feature Upsampling via Geometry-Aware Ray Representation
task: Ultra-lightweight universal feature upsampling via geometry-aware ray representation
key_results: RaysUp achieves SOTA on dense prediction with 16% parameters of AnyUp; 7× faster inference; maintains semantic fidelity across tasks
comments: Ray domain lifting with 6D Plucker coordinates injects implicit 3D geometric priors; geometry-aware neighborhood attention preserves bilateral consistency.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ray representation improves feature upsampling efficiency
hypotheses.result: True; achieves better accuracy-efficiency tradeoff than attention-based schemes

title: A natural programmable metamaterial controls 3D curvature of compound eyes
task: Decode developmental mechanism programming 3D curvature of compound eyes
key_results: Basal retinal surface organized as supracellular triangular mesh with species-specific 2D size distribution; this pattern guides adult eye local curvature; mechanism conserved between D. melanogaster and D. mauritania
comments: The metamaterial analogy is elegant but the causal link between triangle size patterning and 3D curvature relies heavily on computational modeling; experimental perturbation validation is mentioned but not detailed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: 2D supracellular triangular mesh patterning encodes 3D eye curvature via metamaterial properties
hypotheses.result: Species-specific triangle size pattern correlates with adult eye curvature; genetic perturbations alter both pattern and curvature

title: Adaptable centriole biogenesis via the intrinsically disordered protein ALMS1
task: Elucidate cartwheel scaffold dynamics in centriole biogenesis
key_results: ALMS1 acts as external cofactor triggering cartwheel seed (CS) formation without incorporation; CS disassembly during mitosis requires ALMS1; ALMS1 depletion aborts CS assembly while reintroduction reinitializes biogenesis with heritable architectural variants
comments: The invocation of 'memory' in IDP-mediated cycles is speculative and would benefit from mechanistic detail on how information persists across assembly-disassembly cycles.

hypotheses.hypothesis: ALMS1 acts as a template-free physical cofactor enabling cartwheel seed formation
hypotheses.result: CS forms without ALMS1 incorporation; reintroduction restores biogenesis

hypotheses.hypothesis: ALMS1-mediated CS disassembly is coupled to mitotic entry and cartwheel disassembly
hypotheses.result: Temporal correlation observed; hypomorph mutations cause aberrant cartwheel shedding and ectopic centriole formation

title: Genome-wide absolute quantification of chromatin looping
task: Quantify absolute chromatin looping probabilities genome-wide
key_results: Mean pairwise looping probability 1.2% (max 25%); CTCF–CTCF loops stronger than cis-regulatory loops (2.2% vs <1%); calibration method using live-imaging data applied to 65,929 loops in mouse embryonic stem cells
comments: Calibration via live-imaging is powerful but the extension to human cells relies on unspecified assumptions that may not hold across different chromatin states and cell types.

model_io.model: Mouse embryonic stem cells chromatin 3D structure

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chromatin loops occur with low absolute probabilities genome-wide
hypotheses.result: Mean looping probability 1.2%; generalizes live-imaging results to genome-wide scale

hypotheses.hypothesis: CTCF-mediated loops have higher strength than cis-regulatory loops
hypotheses.result: CTCF–CTCF loops 2.2% vs cis-regulatory <1%

title: Enhanced magnetic moment discrimination for multiplex nanoparticle quantification via dual-frequency nonlinearity probing
task: Enhance magnetic moment discrimination for multiplex nanoparticle quantification
key_results: Dual-frequency nonlinearity probing achieves 8.9% deviation in binary mixture ratio quantification for MNPs differing 3-fold in magnetic moment without prior constituent information; method accommodates three independent contrast channels
comments: The spectral symmetry analysis elegantly decouples amplitude and rate-related nonlinearities, but practical multiplexing beyond three channels and robustness to particle-particle interactions require further validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Higher-order magnetization derivatives enhance resolution in magnetic-moment space
hypotheses.result: Binary mixture composition determined with 8.9% accuracy; three-channel multiplexing feasible

title: Cell engulfment defines spatially distinct competitive metabolic niches associated with clinical outcomes in colorectal cancer
task: Characterize cell-in-cell (CIC) formation as manifestation of cell competition and its spatial metabolic organization in colorectal cancer
key_results: CICs occur between cancer cells, CSC-like cells, and cytotoxic T cells; engulfed cells exhibit loser phenotype (increased apoptosis, reduced proliferation); outer cancer cells show winner phenotype (upregulated glycolysis); glucose accumulates in inner cells during lysosomal degradation; CIC neighbourhoods show metabolic stress; cytotoxic T cells within CIC neighbourhoods correlate with improved patient outcomes
comments: The spatial metabolic analysis of CIC neighbourhoods is sophisticated and clinically relevant, though causal roles of competition in cancer evolution versus passenger phenomenon remain debated.

model_io.model: Spatially resolved single-cell analysis of colorectal cancer patient tumors and live-cell time-lapse experiments

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cell engulfment creates spatially organized competitive metabolic niches in tumors
hypotheses.result: CIC neighbourhoods show distinct metabolic stress; CSC-like cells and cytotoxic T cells exhibit increased metabolic stress in proximity to engulfment

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cytotoxic T cell presence in CIC neighbourhoods associates with improved outcomes
hypotheses.result: Co-occurrence of cancer cells with CSC-like populations and cytotoxic T cells within CIC regions correlates with better patient survival

title: Inflammation impairs fertility and oocyte quality in systemic lupus erythematosus by triggering oxidative stress-mediated ferroptosis
task: Elucidate mechanism linking SLE-induced inflammation to oocyte quality deterioration via ferroptosis
key_results: Chronic SLE impairs oocyte maturation, developmental competence, and causes mitochondrial dysfunction with increased oxidative stress and ferroptosis markers; hydroxychloroquine and melatonin attenuate abnormalities; ferrostatin-1 (ferroptosis inhibitor) partially restores meiotic maturation and oocyte quality
comments: The ferroptosis-oocyte quality link is novel and mechanistically interesting, though partial rescue by ferroptosis inhibition suggests other parallel pathways contribute to SLE-associated reproductive dysfunction.

model_io.model: Chronic SLE mouse model with oocyte analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: SLE inflammation drives oxidative stress and ferroptosis in oocytes, impairing quality
hypotheses.result: Chronic SLE increases oxidative stress, ferroptosis markers, and reduces oocyte developmental competence

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ferroptosis inhibition partially rescues SLE-induced oocyte dysfunction
hypotheses.result: Ferrostatin-1 ameliorates ferroptosis alterations and partially restores meiotic maturation

title: Gravitational and mechanical forces shape mitochondrial translation
task: Elucidate how gravity and mechanical forces regulate mitochondrial translation
key_results: Microgravity reduces mitochondrial translation genome-wide in mammalian cells and C. elegans; FAK-RAC1-PAK1-BAD-Bcl-2 signaling and mtFAS pathway activate translation via reduced malonylation of translational machinery; system operates in skeletal muscle mechanotransduction
comments: Novel mechanistic coupling of gravity/adhesion to mitochondrial protein synthesis via mtFAS is creative, though in vivo validation in tissues beyond muscle is limited.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Gravity activates mitochondrial translation via laminin-integrin cell adhesion
hypotheses.result: Microgravity reduces mitochondrial translation; attenuation of cell adhesion mimics phenotype

hypotheses.hypothesis: FAK-RAC1-PAK1-BAD-Bcl-2-mtFAS axis mediates gravity-dependent translation activation

title: Lineage tracing from cellular heritage to disease destiny
task: Review advances in high-resolution cell lineage tracing to decode how cellular ancestry shapes disease fate
key_results: Recent tools (refined recombinase systems, synthetic/natural barcoding) enable high-resolution reconstruction of cellular ancestries in vivo; integration with single-cell multi-omics promises unified framework for decoding lineage-dependent disease programs in cancer, cardiovascular disease, and aging
comments: This is a comprehensive review highlighting methodological advances rather than novel experimental findings; practical scalability of combined lineage tracking and multi-omics remains challenging.

title: Distinct ATRX functions cooperate with 9-1-1 and CST complexes to safeguard replication and telomere integrity
task: Determine context-dependent roles of ATRX in genome and telomere stability via CST and 9-1-1 complexes

title: Non-ablative fractional laser 1940-nm treatment modulates epigenetic signatures associated with skin aging in a split-face investigation
task: Determine if non-ablative fractional laser (NAFL) durably remodels skin methylome and reverses aging trajectories
key_results: 1940-nm NAFL treatment induces 635 differentially methylated regions (DMRs) emerging 1 month post-final treatment, expanding through 3 months, and stabilizing by 6 months; enriched pathways: epidermal differentiation, collagen organization, wound response, stem-cell maintenance; NAFL reversed age-associated methylation at 83.9% of strongly differential CpGs; treatment paralleled significant clinical improvements
comments: The durability of methylation changes (6-month stability) and reversal of aging trajectories at 83.9% of CpGs is impressive, though tissue-level phenotypic validation (collagen deposition, skin elasticity) beyond VISIA measurements would strengthen claims.

title: Using new approach methodologies (NAMs) to investigate ZnONPs and UVR induced skin sensitization
task: Identify inflammasome pathways and oxidative stress mechanisms in ZnONPs and UVR-induced skin sensitization
key_results: ZnONPs + UVR co-exposure causes barrier dysfunction, epidermal hyperplasia, mast cell degranulation, elevated IgE, and Th2 cytokine upregulation; keratinocytes activate canonical NLRP3 inflammasome via oxidative stress and mitochondrial dysfunction; dendritic cells activate alternative TLR4-RIPK1-FADD-caspase-8 inflammasome
comments: The dichotomy between pyroptotic (keratinocyte) and non-pyroptotic (dendritic cell) inflammasome pathways is mechanistically interesting, though the upstream signals distinguishing the two remain partially unclear.

title: Senescence inhibition by rapamycin mitigates radiation-induced atherosclerotic characteristics in human coronary endothelial cells
task: Demonstrate rapamycin mitigates IR-induced senescence and pro-atherogenic phenotype in endothelial cells
key_results: IR induces senescence (elevated SA-β-gal, p53/p21 expression) and atherogenic dysfunction (impaired barrier, increased monocyte adhesion); rapamycin attenuates senescence and dysfunction; mTOR inhibition identified as therapeutic target
comments: Transcriptomic/proteomic evidence is comprehensive, but causality between senescence and atherogenic phenotype remains correlative rather than mechanistically proven.

model_io.model: Human coronary artery endothelial cell (HCAEC) ionizing radiation model

hypotheses.hypothesis: IR drives pro-atherogenic phenotype through cellular senescence induction
hypotheses.result: IR triggers senescence hallmarks and dysfunctional barrier/adhesion phenotypes

hypotheses.hypothesis: mTOR inhibition via rapamycin attenuates IR-induced senescence and atherogenic effects
hypotheses.result: Rapamycin reduces senescence markers and restores barrier/adhesion function

title: UC-MSCs prevent cigarette smoke-induced early cellular senescence like phenotype in bronchial epithelial cells via the SIRT1/PGC-1α pathway
task: Determine if UC-MSCs prevent CSE-induced senescence in bronchial epithelial cells via SIRT1/PGC-1α
key_results: CSE induces mitochondrial dysfunction and ROS accumulation driving senescence; UC-MSCs activate SIRT1/PGC-1α pathway reducing senescence markers and restoring mitochondrial function; SIRT1 inhibitor EX527 reverses protection
comments: The study demonstrates a plausible therapeutic pathway for COPD, though the mechanistic link between SIRT1/PGC-1α activation and senescence inhibition could be more deeply characterized.

model_io.model: In vitro cigarette smoke extract (CSE) exposure model

hypotheses.hypothesis: UC-MSCs activate SIRT1/PGC-1α pathway to mitigate CSE-induced senescence
hypotheses.result: UC-MSCs reduce senescence markers and improve mitochondrial function; EX527 reverses effect

title: Cpeb4 regulates cardiomyocyte apoptosis in heart failure with association to Eif4a2 splicing modulation
task: Determine role of CPEB4 RNA-binding protein in cardiomyocyte apoptosis during heart failure via Eif4a2 splicing
key_results: ISO-induced HF model shows cardiac hypertrophy and increased Cpeb4; siRNA knockdown of Cpeb4 reduces apoptosis by ~60% and restores Eif4a2 isoform expression
comments: The Cpeb4-Eif4a2 axis is identified as a potential therapeutic target, but functional validation that Eif4a2 isoforms directly mediate cardioprotection is limited.

model_io.model: Chronic ISO heart failure mouse model and HL-1 cardiomyocyte ISO injury model

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cpeb4 overexpression drives ISO-induced cardiomyocyte apoptosis
hypotheses.result: Cpeb4 knockdown significantly attenuates apoptosis and enhances viability

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cpeb4 regulates Eif4a2 splicing; altered splicing contributes to apoptosis
hypotheses.result: Cpeb4 depletion corrects dysregulated Eif4a2 splicing and restores major isoform expression

title: Identification of chemical features for improved outer membrane permeation in mycobacteria using machine learning
task: Identify chemical features governing mycobacterial outer membrane permeation using machine learning
key_results: 1,572 compounds profiled via PAC-MAN assay; nitrogen-containing aromatics (indole) and specific scaffolds identified as chemical predictors of mycomembrane permeation; features validated across three molecule series
comments: Practical ML approach integrating bioorthogonal chemistry; predictive features may guide antibiotic development for M. tuberculosis, though in vivo efficacy confirmation remains necessary.

inputs: PAC-MAN assay mycomembrane permeation data (M. tuberculosis and M. smegmatis)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Nitrogen-containing aromatic scaffolds predict mycomembrane permeation and anti-TB activity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: indole and related scaffolds associated with improved permeation and activity across validation series

title: Clinical decision support in hematological malignancies using a case-grounded AI agent
task: Provide clinical decision support for hematological malignancies using case-grounded LLM agent
key_results: HemaGuide achieved 82.8% concordance with tumor board on prospective unselected cases; 81.8% external validation across 555 cases from second center; hallucination rate 0.3% (2/664 cases); median latency 39 s
comments: Novel case-grounding and routing strategy improves LLM reliability for complex clinical scenarios; real-time deployment on commodity hardware is practical, but systematic monitoring for cognitive biases (as shown in paper [11]) remains critical.

model_io.model: HemaGuide (modular LLM agent with routing logic)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Case-grounded routing with specialized decision modes improves LLM concordance with expert tumor boards

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLM-assisted residents achieve near-senior decision-making concordance

title: Exploring the specific heat capacity of aqueous blends of K2CO3- PZ-MEA in CO2 capture using ANN and RSM models
task: Specific heat capacity prediction of K2CO3-PZ-MEA aqueous blends for CO2 capture
key_results: MLP optimal model: MSE 0.0001, R² 0.9993; superior to RSM and RBF approaches; trained on 527 experimental data points
comments: ANN (especially MLP) significantly outperforms RSM; incorporation of physical properties (density, molecular weight) alongside temperature improves prediction accuracy.

hypotheses.hypothesis: ANN with physical property inputs better captures nonlinear CP relationships in CO2 capture solutions than polynomial RSM models

title: Interferometric scattering for optical tomoslicing of transparent solids
task: Sub-10 nm axial resolution optical slicing of transparent solids using interferometric scattering
key_results: Axial resolution improved from ~2 µm to sub-10 nm; kerf width as narrow as 7 nm at 400 mm²/s efficiency; mass loss reduced from ~30% to <1% in laser wafering
comments: Transformative manufacturing breakthrough exploiting laser-scattering interference; unprecedented precision enables nearly lossless crystal, photovoltaic, and microelectronic processing.

model_io.model: Transparent solid with deliberately seeded nano-scatterers

hypotheses.hypothesis: Controlled interference between incident laser and seeded scattering centers achieves sub-10 nm axial resolution

title: Boundary geometry controls a topological defect transition that determines lumen nucleation in embryonic development
task: Boundary geometry control of 3D topological defects and lumen nucleation in embryonic development
key_results: Charge-preserving defect configuration transition driven by embryo boundary geometry; 3D polar defects mark lumen initiation sites; experimental perturbations create predicted additional lumina near defect locations
comments: Novel mechanistic link between topology and embryonic morphogenesis; defect-control principle likely generalizable to active matter systems with orientational order.

model_io.model: Mouse embryo with anisotropic polarized cell tissue

hypotheses.hypothesis: Boundary geometry controls 3D polar defect configurations independent of material parameters
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: charge-preserving transition observed; defect-lumen correspondence validated

title: Electron–phonon coupling and symmetry breaking in superconducting oxide interfaces near ferroelectric quantum criticality
task: Linking electron-phonon coupling to superconductivity via lattice instabilities near ferroelectric quantum criticality
key_results: Superconductivity correlates with inversion symmetry breaking and appearance of high-frequency localized phonons at LaAlO₃/SrTiO₃ interfaces; strong electron-phonon coupling mediated by tunable polar vibrations with carrier-density dependence
comments: Direct spectroscopic evidence of phonon dynamics in interface superconductivity; confines mechanism to lattice instabilities rather than purely electronic pairing.

model_io.model: LaAlO₃/SrTiO₃ interface near ferroelectric quantum critical point

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tunable localized polar phonons mediate electron pairing in quantum paraelectric superconductors
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: superconductivity correlates with high-frequency phonon appearance and electron-phonon coupling evolution

title: Real-space imaging of the electron-pair density hole in molecular Auger–Meitner decay
task: Real-space imaging of electron-pair density evolution during Auger-Meitner decay
key_results: Direct measurement of radial electron-pair density changes on ultrafast timescales; isolation of correlated electron motion before molecular dissociation in SF₆
comments: Novel use of hard X-ray scattering to access electron correlation dynamics; demonstrates feasibility of ultrafast electronic structure probing on picosecond scales.

model_io.model: Sulfur hexafluoride molecule undergoing Auger-Meitner decay

hypotheses.hypothesis: Second-order X-ray interaction can trigger and probe decay dynamics within single pulse
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: electron loss and redistribution captured before dissociation

title: Sequence-defined donor-acceptor-donor oligo(para-phenylene ethynylene)s with emission across the visible spectrum

title: Wave dispersion analysis of porous functionally graded piezoelectric sandwich panels on Kerr substrates
task: Wave dispersion analysis in graphene-reinforced functionally graded piezoelectric sandwich panels
key_results: Scale effects, pore volume fraction, and functional gradient exponent distinctly affect frequency and phase velocity; coupled effects of environmental and electrical loading on wave propagation identified

hypotheses.hypothesis: Scale effects, porosity, and functional gradients independently modulate dispersion characteristics

title: Experimental stopping power estimation in a homogeneous phantom via prompt gamma timing towards proton therapy monitoring
task: Proton therapy stopping power estimation via prompt gamma timing (SER-PGT)
key_results: Stopping power recovery with 8% ± 3% average error vs. NIST PSTAR; range assessment accuracy of 3 mm standard deviation across 4 cm air gap

title: Near-infrared laser-induced plastic (polyethylene terephthalate (PET)) degradation with photosensitizers based on resonant energy transfer mechanism
task: Near-infrared laser-induced plastic (PET) degradation using photosensitizers
key_results: 60% mass loss of PET achieved with MgB₂ photosensitizer using 3 W NIR laser; LUMO level of MgB₂ matches PET bond dissociation limit for resonant energy transfer
comments: Green photonics approach demonstrates practical PET recycling; resonant energy transfer mechanism is elegant but requires precise photosensitizer selection.

model_io.model: PET polymer with MgB₂, graphite, or TiB₂ photosensitizers

hypotheses.hypothesis: Resonant LUMO-band dissociation matching enables PET degradation at modest light intensity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: MgB₂ achieves 60% mass loss; verified by GC-MS analysis
